newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macmahon plans A$44 mln pref issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macmahon plans A$44 mln pref issue.

text.p: Mining and civil engineering group Macmahon Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it planned a converting preference share issue to raise A$44 million.
The money raised in the issue opening on September 2 would be used to fund the group's continued strong growth and to partially reduce debt, Macmahon said.

Each converting preference share would convert into one ordinary share on November 15, 2000 and, subject to market conditions, a bonus issue of one share per converting preference would be made, Macmahon said.

The issue was being underwritten by Macquarie Underwriting and 34 million of the 44 million shares being issued at A$1 per share would be offered to Macquarie clients. The remaining 10 million shares would be offered to Macmahon shareholders.
